text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. Using the SMART framework helps teams define objectives that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Once goals are set, it is important to break the project into milestones, which act as checkpoints to track progress. Deliverables should also be clearly identified so everyone knows what needs to be produced. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial: all key people must agree on the goals and expectations from the start. When these elements are in place, projects run more smoothly and teams can avoid confusion and wasted effort.
